args.summary:
Built a 2D spine-beam OpenSeesPy model of the three-span (30+45+30 m) cast-in-place prestressed single-cell box girder unit.

Key decisions:
- Idealization: spine_beam_2d (MR-01); system: continuous_on_piers (MR-05), since Pier 1 (h=6 m) and Pier 2 (h=29 m) twin circular columns are modelled as elastic beam-columns fixed at base with mass.
- Girder section (cast_box, C55): integrated A = 7.05 m², I = 4.77748 m⁴; Ec = 35500 MPa (C55); γ = 26.0 kN/m³ (prestressed concrete upper limit); w = 183.3 kN/m, m = 18.685 t/m (self-weight of girders only).
- Bearings: Abutments 0 & 3 and Pier 2 = PTFE sliding laminated elastomeric (2/line, longitudinal free, Kh=0); Pier 1 = plain laminated elastomeric fixed (2/line, longitudinal spring). Vertical stiffnesses from JTG 3362-8.7 (S, Ee=5.4GeS², Kv, Eb=2000 MPa), with Ge = 1.2 MPa manufacturer value: Kv₀=3.614e6, Kv₁=8.974e6, Kv₂=8.075e6, Kv₃=3.614e6 kN/m; Kh₁=13091 kN/m.
- Piers: D=1.4 m, 2 columns → A=3.0788 m², I=0.37715 m⁴, Ec=32500 MPa (C40).
- Live load (Class I, one-way, 3 lanes): n_lanes=3, ξ=0.78, qk=10.5 kN/m, Pk = 320/350/320 kN for spans 1–3. Modal analysis gave f1 = 3.2389 Hz → impact factor μ = 0.19197.
